comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and secures an industrial damper, then verifies carriage stopping behavior; pr-1933 mixes flour and liquid into dough. Meaningfully different objectives.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests small-tool alignment, threaded locking, collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative dynamic tuning. pr-1933 tests sustained spoon stirring while stabilizing a mobile bowl and managing granular contents. Bimanual stabilization and tool use are generic shared primitives only.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two non-bottoming, non-overloaded stops with no hard-stop strike, excessive rebound, or setting drift. pr-1933 scores the mixed-flour fraction, with zero for excessive bowl tip or material loss. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift, and torque thresholds; both pr-1933 spec versions provide equivalent quantitative mixing/spill criteria.
comparison.reason: The records test different physical phenomena and abilities: retained mechanical adjustment under impact versus content incorporation with spill and tip control.
